items.title: Delete the stray 'orphans' junk file at repo root
items.context: git rm the tracked root file 'orphans' (5 bytes, content 'NO -'). After: `git ls-files orphans` returns nothing; build + e2e unaffected.
items.userSees: `git ls-files orphans` returns nothing; the junk file is gone.

happy.desc: Run `git ls-files orphans` -> returns empty (exit 0, zero stdout lines); WHY: confirms orphans is untracked/deleted from git index
Run `test -f orphans && echo EXISTS || echo GONE` -> prints GONE; WHY: confirms file is absent from working tree on disk
Run `npm run build` -> exits 0; WHY: confirms deletion of orphans does not break tsc compilation

edge.desc: Run `git log --diff-filter=D --name-only -- orphans | head -5` -> shows orphans in a delete commit; WHY: confirms the deletion is committed to git history, not just unstaged

Run `git checkout HEAD -- orphans 2>&1; echo $?` -> fails (exit non-zero) because file no longer exists at HEAD; WHY: proves the file cannot be restored from current HEAD, deletion is finalized in the commit

adversarial.desc: Run `git grep -rnE "orphans" -- packages/ scripts/ bin/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -v CHANGELOG | grep -v \.md` -> returns empty; WHY: ensures no source code or config accidentally references the junk filename as an import path, config key, or fixture string

verificationEvidence.note: Returns empty — orphans removed from git index.
File absent from disk.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:e2e
verificationEvidence.note: After deletion, tsc build exit 0 AND full npm run test:e2e ALL PASS (story-lifecycle + gap-convergence) — combining build with the assertion-driven e2e suite proves no live consumer was broken.
orphans appears in deletion commit history.
Fails — file absent at HEAD (deletion finalized).
No accidental references to 'orphans' in code (empty).

items.title: Delete 2 truly-dead source modules (phase-protocol + bridge-utils) and verify no residual references
items.context: git rm packages/main/src/core/phase-protocol.ts and packages/main/src/verifier/bridge-utils.ts. Each has 0 static imports AND 0 dynamic/path consumers (verified). Confirm after: (a) git grep for static import patterns of either module name across packages/scripts/bin returns no live code import; (b) git grep for dist path references (dist/core/phase-protocol.js, dist/verifier/bridge-utils.js) and dynamic import() calls referencing them across packages including tests/fixtures returns nothing; (c) intent-coverage.ts STILL EXISTS (the discarded-B-5740 false-positive guard); (d) `npm run build` (tsc) and `npm run test:e2e` pass.
items.userSees: The 2 modules are gone; intent-coverage.ts still present; `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` pass; no live code or fixture references them.
